title: athyrium umbrosum
intro: Athyrium umbrosum, commonly known as the Lady Fern, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Athyriaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use as an anti-inflammatory agent to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium umbrosum include its antioxidant, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
